title: Greeto internal placement snapshot payload v1
description: Initial internal verification profile for PLT-004; not a public API or a deployed control-plane protocol. Schema validation does not verify signature, trust, time, namespace, epoch history or durability. Detached signature is ordinary Ed25519 over the exact UTF-8 payload prefixed with greeto-placement-snapshot/v1 followed by a zero byte. Keys come from trusted configuration, never this document. Duplicate and case-variant JSON keys are rejected by the Go parser. Production activation requires controller/checkpoint/trust-profile review.

schema_version.description: Implementation profile version; no automatic migration.

audience.description: Expected consumer group/profile, not a browser input.

environment_id.description: Exact environment binding for the full snapshot.

key_id.description: Hint resolving a configured public key; also authenticated inside payload.

version.description: Snapshot generation; rollback or same-generation different digest is rejected.

issued_at.description: Cannot be in the future or before the public-key validity interval.

expires_at.description: Must remain future at activation and each lookup, within MaxLifetime and key validity.

provider.description: Provider namespace; matched to trusted callback-route configuration.

app_ref.description: Application namespace owned by the configured route.

asset_id.description: Provider asset as an opaque string; numeric IDs are not converted.

tenant_id.description: Authorized tenant from the placement controller.

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace belonging to that tenant.

environment_id.description: Environment must exactly match directory configuration.

region.description: Permitted home region; must be in the trusted local allowlist.

cell_id.description: Home cell; changing it requires a higher ownership epoch.

placement_epoch.description: Monotonic per-asset epoch; same-epoch ownership/location/state changes are rejected.

state.description: Only active can resolve. Tombstones cannot be silently omitted from subsequent snapshots.

entries.description: Full namespace replacement with unique provider/app/asset tuples. Actual MaxEntries and MaxBytes are explicit, lower runtime limits. This initial bounded profile requires at least one entry or tombstone.
